blocks.text: Atom ki electronic configuration yeh bhi batati hai ke us ke shells mein electrons kaise baante gaye hain. Shells ko K, L, M, N waghaira kehte hain; yeh orbitals ke principal quantum number (n) ke mutabiq hain.
Har shell mein electrons ki ek khaas capacity (gunjaish) hai:

items: K shell (n = 1): zyada se zyada 2 electrons (1s orbital)
L shell (n = 2): zyada se zyada 8 electrons (2s aur 2p orbitals)
M shell (n = 3): zyada se zyada 18 electrons (3s, 3p aur 3d orbitals)
N shell (n = 4): zyada se zyada 32 electrons (4s, 4p, 4d aur 4f orbitals)
Sodium (Na): 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹ (K, L aur M shells; yani 2, 8, 1)

blocks.prompt: Chlorine (Z = 17) aur calcium (Z = 20) ki shell configuration (2, 8, ...) likhein.
blocks.explanation: Chlorine ke 17 electrons: K mein 2, L mein 8, M mein 7, yani 2, 8, 7. Calcium ke 20: 2, 8, 8, 2, kyun ke 3s aur 3p bharne ke baad agle do electrons N shell ke 4s mein jate hain (3d se pehle).

items: K, L, M, N (n = 1 se 4) mein zyada se zyada 2, 8, 18, 32 electrons.
